data.notes: April 2027 currently has a sparse confirmed calendar: the reliable picture is late-season après-ski/live-band and nightclub programming in Verbier plus a nearby 4 Vallées electronic festival.

events.title: Snow Vibes Festival 2027
events.summary: Snow Vibes 2027 is confirmed for April 2027 in Nendaz, within the 4 Vallées area, as a two-day high-altitude electronic festival with international electronic, techno and dance artists. The official page lists the venue at 2,200 meters above sea level with a 7,000-visitor, cable-car-accessed festival setup.

events.title: Farinet Après-ski Live Music Season
events.summary: Farinet Après-ski’s winter season runs through 11 April 2027, with live music listed every evening from 18:00 to 21:00. It is one of Verbier’s defining après-ski party rooms rather than a one-off concert.

events.title: Farm Club Winter Weekend Nights
events.summary: Farm Club’s winter opening period is confirmed through 11 April 2027, with Friday and Saturday club hours listed from 23:00 to 04:00. The long-running Verbier nightclub is positioned as a central late-night dance-floor institution in the resort.

events.title: SOUTH Restaurant & Club Winter DJ and Jazz/Soul Nights
events.summary: SOUTH’s winter club season is listed through 17 April 2027, with DJs and late-night dancing; its venue description also highlights Jazz & Soul Thursdays and resident/guest DJs through the season. This is a solid late-season Verbier nightlife pick rather than a named festival lineup.

events.title: Farinet Lounge Bar nightly DJ residency
events.venueName: Farinet Lounge Bar / SOUTH Restaurant & Club
events.summary: Season-long central Verbier après-to-late-night programme: DJ-led lounge sessions from 21:00, with the connected SOUTH space described as shifting into one of Verbier’s livelier nightclub settings on weekends, confirmed open through 24 April 2027.

events.title: Le Rouge winter DJ programme
events.summary: Le Rouge’s confirmed winter-season public events programme with contemporary DJ programming continues through 25 April 2027, covering Verbier’s après-ski-to-evening terrace party lane rather than a one-off arena show.

events.title: Taratata festive late-night DJ sets
events.summary: Taratata’s season listing confirms festive late-night parties with DJ sets during its 3 December 2026–30 April 2027 operating period, making it a smaller but verified Verbier nightlife option for April 2027.
